snippet.title: DICTOCRACY - FINAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
I am on the final lap now. This is the latest trailer for my game. I'll be participating in the upcoming Next Fest and then finally releasing in about a month.

Espionage and Warfare are under development. Enemy AI for these features is the only remaining item being worked on. So yes, I feel that the game is almost there.

The demo also launched on Steam so I'm hoping that many people pick it up and let me know their feelings about the game.

Just to recap about Dictocracy - Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough.

Will you lead Adelphia to glory and get re-elected or will you fail as many others before you ? Your destiny lies in your hands !

WISHLIST TODAY -  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310870/DICTOCRACY/
